welcome.headline: Bring your financial plan together here.
welcome.description: Bring accounts, budgets, and supported investments together to see what you have, where it goes, and how it changes over time.
welcome.socialProof: Built for people managing money across banks, budgets, and investments.
welcome.proof: People stick with financial tools when progress becomes visible: savings, spending, net worth, and goals in one place.
welcome.proofNote: Budgeting app users report less money stress and stronger savings habits when they track progress consistently.

goals.headline: What do you want to improve first?
goals.description: We'll shape setup around the financial picture you want to build.
goals.proof: Written financial goals are easier to follow when they are broken into steps and reviewed regularly.

helpers.all_in_one: Bring accounts, budgets, and supported investments together.
helpers.spending: See where money goes each month.
helpers.budget: Turn spending into a simple plan.
helpers.investments_net_worth: Keep cash, investments, and net worth together.
helpers.exploring: Take a quick look around first.

goals.proofNote: People with realistic financial goals are more likely to save, and progress checks help turn goals into habits.

account.headline: Connect one account to see real balances.
account.description: One account is enough to show balances, recent activity, and the starting point for your net worth.
account.trustShort: Read-only access. WonderMoney cannot move money or make payments.
account.trustLong: You authenticate directly with your bank through Enable Banking. WonderMoney never sees your login details, and you can revoke access anytime.

personalized.all_in_one: Connect one account first. WonderMoney can start showing your balances and recent activity from there.
personalized.spending: Connect your account to start seeing recent spending and categories.
personalized.budget: Start with one account so your budget reflects real spending.
personalized.investments_net_worth: Connect one account first. It gives WonderMoney the cash side of your net worth.
personalized.financial_freedom: Start with one account so balances, spending, and investments build a reliable picture.
personalized.exploring: Start with one account, or add one manually, and see how WonderMoney works.

skipWarning.headline: Continue without real financial data?
skipWarning.description: You can, but WonderMoney will not be able to show your real balances, transactions, spending patterns, or net worth until you add an account.
skipWarning.reassurance: You can always add one later from Accounts.

credentialRequired.title: Connecting a bank needs a quick one-time setup
credentialRequired.body: Before you can link a real bank, add your own Enable Banking key from Settings. You can do that anytime after setup — for now, add an account manually above or skip this step and connect later.

connect.listHint: Choose your bank to connect securely.
connect.handoffBody: You'll authenticate through Enable Banking. WonderMoney never sees your login details.
connect.handoffError: We couldn't start the connection. Try again or pick another bank.
connect.connectErrorBanner: Connection wasn't completed. Try again or pick another bank.
connect.manualBody: No connection needed. Enter a balance to start — you can connect it for automatic updates later.
connect.manualNote: Manual accounts are included in your net worth but won't update automatically.

syncing.processing: Connected — pulling in your balances and transactions…
syncing.succeeded: Your accounts are connected and synced.
syncing.partial: Connected. Some data is still coming in — we'll keep syncing in the background.
syncing.trouble: Connected. Finishing the first sync is taking a little longer — we'll keep trying in the background.

syncValue.connectedHeadline: Your financial picture is filling in.
syncValue.connectedDescription: Balances, transactions, budgets, and net worth become more useful as real data comes in.
syncValue.skippedHeadline: You can explore, but real data unlocks the value.
syncValue.skippedDescription: Add an account later to unlock real balances, transactions, spending insights, and net worth tracking.

balances.title: Balances
balances.description: See your accounts together instead of checking each bank separately.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Recent transactions help WonderMoney show where your money goes.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Budgets work better when they are based on real spending.

netWorth.title: Net worth
netWorth.description: Accounts and portfolios combine into one number: your net worth.

syncValue.proofNote: Regular net worth tracking gives people a measurable way to see financial progress over time.

inProgress.title: What's happening right now
inProgress.balances: Reading your account details and current balances.
inProgress.transactions: Pulling in your transaction history — up to 12 months, depending on what your bank shares.
inProgress.categories: Sorting each transaction into a category as it arrives.

syncValue.openBankingNote: 16.5 million active open banking connections in the UK by December 2025, up 36% in a year. Connecting a bank this way is now ordinary.

privacy.headline: Read-only means read-only.
privacy.description: WonderMoney can show balances and transactions, but it cannot move money, make payments, or see your bank login details.

readOnly.title: Read-only access
readOnly.description: WonderMoney can view balances and transactions only. It cannot move money, make payments, or initiate transfers.

bankAuth.title: You sign in with your bank
bankAuth.description: Authentication happens through Enable Banking. WonderMoney never sees your bank login details.

revoke.title: You stay in control
revoke.description: You can revoke access at any time from your bank or from Accounts in WonderMoney.

budget.headline: Give your money a plan.
budget.description: A budget turns your spending into clear categories, limits, and trade-offs. Once transactions are connected, WonderMoney can help keep it updated.
budget.personalized: You said budgeting matters to you. This is where WonderMoney helps turn your spending into a monthly plan.
budget.accountSkipped: You can create a budget now, but it works best once an account is connected and transactions are available.
budget.reassurance: You can start simple and adjust later.

portfolio.headline: Complete your net worth picture.
portfolio.description: Add your investments so WonderMoney can show your cash, spending, and portfolio in one place.
portfolio.personalized: You said tracking investments and net worth matters to you. Add a portfolio to connect that part of your financial life.
portfolio.reassurance: You can add holdings manually or import them later.

completion.connectedCelebrationDescription: Your dashboard will keep getting clearer as balances and recent transactions sync.
completion.skippedCelebrationDescription: You can explore now. Add one account when you're ready to unlock real balances, transactions, spending insights, and net worth.

dashboard.title: Welcome to your dashboard
dashboard.description: This is your main dashboard – your future go-to spot for a clear overview of your financial life, all in one place.
dashboard.content1: See your net worth across all accounts at a glance.
dashboard.content2: Track budget health and top spending categories as your data refreshes.
dashboard.content3: Connect a bank account to populate your dashboard with real transactions.

accounts.title: Welcome to your accounts
accounts.description: This is your Accounts Overview where you can monitor all your financial accounts in one place.
accounts.content1: View total balance and all connected accounts with trend indicators.
accounts.content2: Track inflows, outflows, and savings rate with balance growth over time.
accounts.content3: Dive into spending categories and individual transaction details.

transactions.title: Welcome to your transactions
transactions.description: Track every financial movement across all your connected accounts in one organized view.
transactions.content1: Every deposit, purchase, and transfer is listed with category and amount.
transactions.content2: Filter by date, account, or category to find any transaction quickly.
transactions.content3: Add transactions manually or import them from a bank statement CSV.

budgets-monthly.title: Welcome to your monthly budget
budgets-monthly.description: Stay on track with your spending goals and easily monitor your progress throughout the month.
budgets-monthly.content1: See spending vs. budget goals for each category at a glance.
budgets-monthly.content2: Spending is auto-updated from your linked bank transactions.
budgets-monthly.content3: Compare this month's progress against your full-year plan.

budgets-yearly.title: Welcome to your yearly budget
budgets-yearly.description: Take control of your annual financial plan and manage less frequent expenses with confidence.
budgets-yearly.content1: Track your annual income, expenses, and projected savings.
budgets-yearly.content2: Monitor spending progress in each category against the yearly budget.
budgets-yearly.content3: Compare year-to-date performance against your full annual plan.
